objective: Daily carbohydrate totals within ±10% using CGM with allowed personal calibration, staying in CGMacros
validation_limitation: Same44 days repeatedly inspected during development; not a fresh prospective or untouched test.
blocker: No demonstrated predictive mapping at requested accuracy in current evaluated CGMacros data. Exhausted currently supported correction hypotheses; cannot certify target by fitting or retuning against known evaluation labels. This is an evidence/validation limit, not a proof of physical impossibility.
resumption_evidence_needed: A new supported conversion hypothesis or verified additional calibration/label information within the authorized CGMacros scope; no such evidence is currently present.
